messages: anna (Design): quick QA — bringing together a couple small things from the settings form: required indicators + how we surface validation on the multi-step flow, and the delete team CTA copy. want to settle before we hand to devs. raj (PM): thanks — what are the current options on the table? tess (DevEx): +1. also accessibility concern: screen-reader hinting for required fields. mike (Eng): can we do both: inline errors for single-step, summary for multi-step? implementation cost is small if we reuse the error component. anna (Design): thinking: pattern A = visible asterisk + 'Required' legend at top for longer forms; pattern B = inline visible label + sr-only "required" for compact fields. anna (Design): sample markup I'm proposing: ``` required ``` anna (Design): rationale: keeps visual density low but still announces required for SRs. aria-required also set on input. raj (PM): for multi-step, what about error summary at top of step with anchor links to fields? users often miss inline errors when scrolled. tess (DevEx): agree. summary should include concise copy and keyboard focus move to first invalid field. also ensure `aria-live` for the summary updates. mike (Eng): implementation note: we can add data-error-anchor attributes and single handler to focus. anna (Design): delete CTA copy debate: current is "Delete team" (danger). alternatives: "Permanently delete team" vs "Remove team and all data". which is clearer and meets legal/reg compliance needs? aj (PM): prefer explicitness: "Permanently delete team" + typed confirm (enter team name) for org-level teams. lightweight teams can use confirm modal with undo toast. tess (DevEx): typed confirm is a11y heavy — needs clear instructions and label. undo toast is useful but not always sufficient for org-level data. anna (Design): proposed modal copy: - Title: "Permanently delete team" - Body: "This will permanently delete the team and all associated data. This action cannot be undone. To confirm, type the team name:" - Input label: "Type team name to confirm" - Primary button: "Delete team" - Secondary: "Cancel" raj (PM): looks good. add a small hint under input: "You can restore within 30 days" if we actually support soft-delete, otherwise remove. mike (Eng): backend supports soft-delete for teams for 14 days currently. so copy should match product reality; raj can make call. anna (Design): accessibility nit: ensure modal traps focus, describes purpose via `aria-describedby`, and that primary CTA has `aria-disabled` until typed-match. tess (DevEx): I'll add acceptance criteria for the dev ticket: focus trap, aria-describedby, error announced via `role=alert` when typed input doesn't match. ux-bot: deploy reminder — branch `feature/team-delete-ux` is out for review :rocket: anna (Design): ok let's finalize: use asterisk + sr-only required, step-level error summary with anchors for multi-step, explicit "Permanently delete team" modal with typed confirm for org teams, undo toast for light deletes. i'll update the spec and push to Figma. raj (PM): great — i'll update the product doc to match, and confirm soft-delete duration with legal. mike (Eng): flagged a small perf note: error summary anchors shouldn't re-render entire form on every validation tick. tess (DevEx): will add keyboard walkthrough to the QA checklist. anna (Design): thanks all :heart: — i'll post the updated spec and ping when ready for handoff.
